scenes.text: This tutorial covers Recruitment. Quantify recruitment of a channel-of-interest signal to parasites or pathogen-associated regions.
Open Recruitment from the Toxoplasma assays section. Use measured cell, parasite, and organelle masks with channel one, endoplasmic reticulum, as the channel of interest.
In the main configuration area, define the recruitment region, background reference, object filters, grouping, and normalization strategy.
Before the full run, review the visible settings and use a preview or test mode when one is available. inspect object-level overlays and control distributions before comparing conditions.
When the workflow finishes, per-object recruitment scores and condition summaries are stored with source identifiers.
